ai.summary: South Korea’s president proposed allocating 21.3 trillion won (about $16 billion) in 2027 to AI and related priorities, nearly twice this year’s amount. The plan includes semiconductors, physical AI, data centers and 4.7 trillion won for frontier AI development, including a domestic model.
ai.title: South Korea’s Lee vows to make bold AI investment in record budget push

ai.summary: Argentina’s President Javier Milei is pitching Patagonia to technology companies as a location for AI data centers, citing available land, energy resources and proposed tax incentives. The pitch also promises minimal AI regulation, as data-center development faces opposition elsewhere.
ai.title: Argentina's Milei pitches a regulation-free AI haven at the end of the world

ai.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman met Samsung executives to discuss memory-chip supply and AI infrastructure, according to the publication. The talks come amid rising data-center demand that is tightening competition for memory chips.
ai.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman meets Samsung executives to discuss memory chip supply, AI infrastructure

quantum.summary: South Korea says it plans to connect its new Hangang supercomputer with a quantum computer in the first half of 2027. The proposed hybrid system is intended to combine high-performance computing and quantum processing.
quantum.title: South Korea Launches Hangang Supercomputer, Plans Quantum Integration

quantum.summary: Researchers report a decoder that uses correlations in neutral-atom losses to improve quantum error correction, with reported logical error rates up to 25 times lower than with earlier methods. The result addresses a failure mode in which the loss of one atom can be correlated with the loss of its gate partner.
quantum.title: Researchers Cut Quantum Errors 25x With New Atom-Loss Decoder

quantum.summary: A proposed neural-network-assisted method called Triage reportedly cuts decoding latency for high-rate quantum LDPC codes by one to two orders of magnitude. In reported Kasai-code tests, convergence exceeded 99.97% with amortized latency around 30 milliseconds; broader scalability remains an open question.
quantum.title: Researchers Cut QLDPC Code Decoding Time Tenfold With New Method

quantum.summary: A study describes using neutral-atom embedding structures as an error-detection code, repurposing ancillary atoms rather than adding hardware. The researchers report recovering exact optimization solutions on QuEra Aquila hardware for systems of up to 107 atoms.
quantum.title: Researchers Correct Errors Using Rydberg Atom Embeddings

quantum.summary: A University of Maryland team presents a framework for analyzing fault tolerance across dynamic quantum circuits, rather than only at individual points in a computation. The method uses subsystem spacetime codes to characterize circuit distances and identify how faults propagate.
quantum.title: Maryland Team Charts Fault Tolerance In Quantum Circuits

quantum.summary: Quantum X Labs says it demonstrated its Qatacomb encryption scheme on an IBM Heron r2 processor, using a 156-qubit machine to reconstruct an encrypted image. This is a company-reported demonstration, not independent confirmation of the scheme’s broader security claims.
quantum.title: Quantum X Labs Announces Cyber Quantum Encryption Breakthrough in Demonstration with IBM Quantum Processor, Heron r2
